BrokerAdapterCertification.description: One versioned adapter conformance and release certification.
BrokerAdapterCertification.title: BrokerAdapterCertification

BrokerCapabilityDeclaration.description:
One capability dimension row of a broker capability matrix.

Contradictory dimensions are rejected: a capability cannot be available
without being implemented.
BrokerCapabilityDeclaration.title: BrokerCapabilityDeclaration

BrokerCapabilityMatrix.description: One source of truth for a profile version's declared capabilities.
BrokerCapabilityMatrix.title: BrokerCapabilityMatrix

BrokerEnvironment.description: One declared broker execution boundary with isolation identity.
BrokerEnvironment.title: BrokerEnvironment

BrokerFailure.description: Structured failure envelope shared by every broker capability.
BrokerFailure.title: BrokerFailure

BrokerHistoryPage.description: One bounded page of provider-native history records.
BrokerHistoryPage.title: BrokerHistoryPage

BrokerMarketState.description: Provider-truth quote, tick, and market-status projection.
BrokerMarketState.title: BrokerMarketState

BrokerOperationOutcome.description: Correlated logical result of one transport operation attempt.
BrokerOperationOutcome.title: BrokerOperationOutcome

BrokerOperationReceipt.description: Append-only provider transport outcome evidence for one attempt.
BrokerOperationReceipt.title: BrokerOperationReceipt

BrokerOperationRequest.description: Trading-owned transport request admitted after Risk authorization.
BrokerOperationRequest.title: BrokerOperationRequest

BrokerProviderProfile.description: One immutable broker provider profile version.
BrokerProviderProfile.title: BrokerProviderProfile

BrokerSessionReadiness.description: Multi-dimensional readiness assessment of a session generation.
BrokerSessionReadiness.title: BrokerSessionReadiness

BrokerSessionState.description: One recorded connection-state transition of a session generation.
BrokerSessionState.title: BrokerSessionState

BrokerTradingState.description: Provider-native positions, orders, and deals of a session generation.
BrokerTradingState.title: BrokerTradingState

BrokerWriteCertification.description: Explicit owner-approved production write release record.
BrokerWriteCertification.title: BrokerWriteCertification

CertifyAdaptersRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated adapter certification request.

RUN_CONFORMANCE requires only ``profile_version_id``; CERTIFY_VERSION
requires only ``certification``; CERTIFY_WRITE requires only
``write_certification``.
CertifyAdaptersRequest.title: CertifyAdaptersRequest

ConfigureProvidersRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated provider configuration request.

CONFIGURE requires only ``profile``; VALIDATE_CREDENTIALS requires
only ``profile_id``.
ConfigureProvidersRequest.title: ConfigureProvidersRequest

DeclareCapabilitiesRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated capability declaration request.

DECLARE_PROFILE requires only ``profile``; DECLARE_MATRIX requires
only ``matrix``.
DeclareCapabilitiesRequest.title: DeclareCapabilitiesRequest

InstrumentRef.description: Reference to one canonical instrument identity.
InstrumentRef.title: InstrumentRef

IsolateEnvironmentsRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated environment isolation request.

DECLARE_ENVIRONMENT, VERIFY_ISOLATION, and RESOLVE_AUTHORITY each
require ``environment``.
IsolateEnvironmentsRequest.title: IsolateEnvironmentsRequest

ManageSessionsRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated session lifecycle request.

Every operation requires ``session``; TRANSITION additionally
requires ``state`` and every other operation forbids it.
ManageSessionsRequest.title: ManageSessionsRequest

ProviderCorrelation.description: Stable idempotent correlation identity of a provider operation.
ProviderCorrelation.title: ProviderCorrelation

ProviderEventPayload.description:
Payload for broker.provider-event DomainEvent envelopes.

The normalized observational event retains the raw provider identity
hash and the fenced session generation; ``findings`` records sequence
gaps, duplicates, late events, and decode failures as classified
evidence. There are no subscriptions; consumers receive these events
through the Interfaces trading stream.
ProviderEventPayload.title: ProviderEventPayload

ProviderRecord.description: One provider-native record preserved for Trading reconciliation.
ProviderRecord.title: ProviderRecord

ProviderRef.description: Reference to one external data provider identity.
ProviderRef.title: ProviderRef

ReadProviderStateRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated provider-truth read request.

READ_ACCOUNT and READ_TRADING_STATE require only ``session``;
READ_MARKET additionally requires ``instrument``; PAGE_HISTORY
permits only paging fields; NORMALIZE_EVENT additionally requires
``raw_event``.
ReadProviderStateRequest.title: ReadProviderStateRequest

TransportOrdersRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated execution transport request.

VALIDATE_REQUEST, SUBMIT, CANCEL, and MODIFY require only
``operation_request``; JOURNAL requires only ``operation_id``.
TransportOrdersRequest.title: TransportOrdersRequest

TransportOrdersSuccess.description:
Successful execution transport operation result.

The ratified field ``outcome`` carries the transport operation
outcome, so the conventional ``Literal["SUCCESS"]`` discriminator of
other success records is represented here by ``result_version`` and
the enclosing success type alone.
TransportOrdersSuccess.title: TransportOrdersSuccess
